1. Sign in

Use your own username and password. The top of the page says You are: your name.

More
  • Not you? Click Not you?. It signs you out.
  • After 30 minutes with no clicks you are signed out (not while photos upload).

2. Scan

  1. Click Scan cards.
  2. Type a batch name (e.g. After Hours).
  3. Drop the photos on the box, or click Scan.

One card per photo, flat, no glare.

More

Needs a look = check the photo · Blocked = fix first · Not added = skipped.

3. Review

Click Review batch →. Check each field, then Approve (or Enter).

  • Yellow = check the photo.
  • Red box = fix it first. If the card really shows it, press Needs admin in the red box.
  • Undo (or Ctrl+Z) undoes your last change, in the current batch only.
More
Do this How
See where a field was read Tap the field. Esc = whole photo.
Fix a field Type, then Save.
Reject Reject, or R. It asks first.
Next / previous card Skip, J / K, or the arrow keys.

changed = the scanner tidied it. Hover to see what it read. Only an admin can confirm a misread in name, title, company or department, or a block on email, website or address. Editing an approved card so it is blocked moves it back to Pending. The message says so.

4. Same person?

If a card looks like another one, you see both side by side.

  • Same: one card is kept, with the new details added.
  • Different: both are kept.

Answer this first. If the person was exported before, Approve asks once: this person will be left out of the next file.

5. Export

  1. Click Export. Your batch is chosen.
  2. Click Preview to check the rows.
  3. Click Export, then Save.
  • Import only the file IMPORT-ME_…xlsx. A Next steps box names it.
  • If cards are left out, the page says why in one line. Read the Left-out list.
More
  • To check = rows to look at before the import. The READ-ME lists them.
  • Edited after export, so it is not in this file unless an admin includes it.
  • Waiting for admin = cards you sent with Needs admin.

6. Ask an admin

Your admin: ask the front desk.

Ask when you are locked out, a red box says An admin needs to confirm this, or you need someone else's batch.
